programs.program_name: Committee on Genetics, Genomics & Systems Biology (GGSB) - PhD in Genetics
programs.phd_evidence_quote: GGSB offers a program of basic study leading to the Doctor of Philosophy in Genetics.
programs.notes: GGSB has empirical and computational tracks (per site nav). The official 'Faculty and Trainers' page (ggsb.uchicago.edu/program/faculty) is a JS directory whose names did not load even with --render; the GGSB 'Research' page lists training faculty with lab links and was used for matching (17 hits incl. duplicate OpenAlex profiles). Department of Genetic Medicine directory (medicine.uchicago.edu/genetic-medicine/faculty-directory) also lists Mengjie Chen, Hae Kyung Im, Andrew Dahl, Xuanyao Liu, Anindita Basu, Sebastian Pott, Yoav Gilad, Jian Zhou.

programs.phd_evidence_quote: The University of Chicago is offering a fundamentally interdisciplinary Ph.D. program in Biophysical Sciences.
programs.notes: Dual-mentor program jointly run by Biological and Physical Sciences Divisions (biosciences.uchicago.edu/programs/biophysical-sciences).

programs.program_name: Graduate Program in Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics (BMB)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: I chose to join the BMB PhD program primarily due to its strong RNA-centric research complemented by labs and facilities that specialize in structural biology and biophysics.
programs.notes: PhD evidence is a student testimonial on the program home page ('Graduate Program in Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics, The University of Chicago'). Faculty list is JS-loaded; plain fetch had 0 names, --render worked.

programs.program_name: PhD in Public Health Sciences (biostatistics area of study)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: The PhD program in the ... at the University of Chicago offers advanced courses of study in biostatistics, epidemiology, and health services research
programs.notes: Not a stand-alone 'PhD in Biostatistics': the degree is a PhD in Public Health Sciences with biostatistics as one of three areas of study (quote has the department name as a link, elided as '...'). Lin Chen verified on rendered faculty list ('Lin Chen, PhD').
